::: {#sol-unseen}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
seen = pair_counts > 0
n_unseen = (~seen[val_ids[:-1], val_ids[1:]]).sum().item()
print(n_unseen)
```

At `r py$n_unseen` of the `r format(length(py$val_ids) - 1, big.mark = ",")` positions after the first,
the pair of characters never occurs in the training text.
The counting estimate of @exm-bigram-model gives each of those `r py$n_unseen` pairs probability 0,
and so the whole validation text probability 0.

:::
